title: EndTools
description: Adds items, blocks, fluids, tools to end dimension.
body:
## **EndTools** is an fabric mod that adds end dimension tools to the game.


**EndTools is in development Expect bugs and changes.**\
**Currently for fabric 1.21.8**\
**Forge and more Versions Comming Soon**


----
### **What mod adds:**

- **EnddustOre** - found in end dimension, When broken drops Enddust.
- **Enddust** - Obtained after breaking EnddustOre, used in crafting.
- **EnddustBlock** - Just an ordinary block.
- **Endalloy** - Obtained from smelting Enddust, used in crafting.
- **EnddustSword** - Just an sword, obtained from crafting.
- **EnddustPickaxe** - Just an pickaxe, obtained from crafting.
- **EnddustShovel** - Just an shovel, obtained from crafting.
- **EnddustAxe** - Just an axe, obtained from crafting.
- **EnddustHoe** - Just an hoe, obtained from crafting.
- **EnddustMeltedAlloy** - Hot fluid, obtained from smelting Endalloy.

----

> ### To craft tools you will need netherite tools.
